en.description:
Introducing the BEST solitaire game for mobile! Solisquare is an all new solitaire game that is fun and easy to play. But don't be fooled, there is more strategy than in regular solitaire

You begin with a standard deck...but as you level up and earn coins, you can unlock new decks! These decks were specifically created for Solisquare. Choose a deck that matches your personality or take the ultimate challenge and collect them all! The more you play, the more decks you can unlock! And look out for special events where you can unlock a FREE deck!

Each round is played with 52 cards. Your goal is to reveal all 52 cards by building up and down in 4 scoring piles. You also have 4 store piles that you can use to store one extra card in to use later. Almost every deal is winnable! 

Earn points and coins for each round played, and bonus points for winning! Points will increase your level rank which will allow you to unlock new decks.

• Battle Mode! - Play against other players from around the world in a two player version! Each player races to get rid of all 52 cards while playing at the same time on the same playing squares! Earn or lose Battle Cred after each match! 

• Play on your Apple TV, iPhone or iPod and your progress and games are saved from device to device! Start a game on your Apple TV and finish it on your phone! There is also an Apple Watch version - designed perfectly to fit on your wrist! The only solitaire game that can be played with no scrolling!

Compete with your friends on the leaderboard - Most points, most wins, longest streak and highest scoring game! Complete achievements and track your progress!

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
• Battle Mode! Race another player to clear your deck! 
• New decks added
• Bug fixes and gameplay enhancements

• Solisquare is ready for iOS 13! This update includes support for Dark Mode and other fun iOS 13 features!
• A new deck selection screen!  Now you can view more information about a deck and see more decks at a time before selecting them
• Music/sound from other apps no longer stops when opening Solisquare.  To listen to the Solisquare soundtrack instead, just go to the settings tab in the main menu and adjust the volume slider.
• Text in deck description is no longer editable
•Various bug fixes and improvements
Thank you for playing Solisquare and we hope you enjoy it!

OCTOBER 2019
• Level 10 - 3 New decks! Show off the all new Fishing, Food, and Sushi decks!
• Enhanced achievements system (more achievements coming soon!)
• Many bug fixes and performance improvements
Thanks for playing Solisquare, we'll see you later this month for something spooky...

HALLOWEEN EVENT
From now until November 4, you have the chance to unlock a spooky Halloween deck!  This deck will give a point bonus every time it is used in a game!  
To unlock this deck, all you have to do is win a game using this deck before the time runs out!  It can be found from the Event button or in the new Specialty tab of the Decks screen.
Have fun, and be spooky!

Plus lots of bug fixes and performance improvements!

New decks! 
      Delaney, Emoji, and Tattoo
Better Dark Mode Support
New Achievement (Foodie)
Bug fixes

THANKSGIVING EVENT
- A special Thanksgiving deck themed around Thanksgiving foods
- Unlock this deck during the event to get a 100 point bonus each time the deck is used!

BLACK FRIDAY SALE
- From Black Friday until Cyber Monday, all decks will cost 50% less! Stock up on all the decks you need before the deal goes away!

BUG FIXES

The BIGGEST Solisquare Update yet!
With 13 new (FREE!) decks, and a new high point scoring mode, Solisquare's new generation just keeps getting better!

DECK THE HALLS EVENT (December 1-January 1)
Every other day leading up to Christmas, a new themed deck will be available for free!  If you unlock all 12 decks, you will be able to unlock a final, festive Christmas deck!

ARCADE MODE 
In the all new arcade mode, the fun doesn't stop when you finish the deck...  The excitement is just getting started!  Rack up high scores by clearing decks, and playing tons of cards in a row without placing a card in an empty space.  If you can manage to get a run of 8 cards in a row, you'll be ON FIRE and will get huge multipliers!  

LOTS OF BUG FIXES - Thanks so much for playing Solisquare!

Arcade mode leaderboard
Pop up for matchmaking on Battle

Three new decks! Unlock the Classic Red, Comedian, and Bri decks! 
Fixed landscape arcade mode UI bug on smaller devices
Bug fixes and performance enhancements

VALENTINE’S DAY EVENT
Earn a special deck to share with your special someone... or your dog. 
THREE NEW DECKS
Classic Blue, Graffiti, Impossible
BUG FIXES

This month, for St Patrick's day, you don't have to worry about getting pinched while playing with any of our new decks because they're all green!
CLASSIC GREEN, GO GREEN, LUKE GREEN
Plus, a special limited time only ST PATRICK'S DAY deck available from March 17-31!
Have fun! And thanks for playing!

Happy Spring!  This month, Solisquare has not one, but TWO special events, each with their own deck!  
APRIL FOOLS - April 1-10
EASTER - April 9-18
Also, we have 3 new level-based decks to celebrate the month of April: Flowers, Van Gogh, and Bible!
Have fun!

A new level with three new decks:
• Isolation, Swim, and Racecar 

Not one, but TWO special events, each with their own FREE, LIMITED EDITION decks:
• Mother's Day
• Memorial Day

A neat new icon!

Have fun, and thanks for playing!

Three new decks: Golf, China, and Candy!
FATHER'S DAY EVENT!   To thank all the dads in the world, we have a free deck of cards available to unlock from June 19-28
SUMMER EVENT!  All summer long, you'll have access to the free summer deck!  Win with it once, it's yours forever!

Have fun, and thanks for playing!
New Event! Celebrate FREEDOM with a FREE 4th Of July Deck!  Only available July 1st-18th.

Level 18 brings you three new decks - Lines, Vegas and Monster Max! 
FREE EVENT ALERT! Get the Free Circulous deck to celebrate the global launch of the new game Circulous on August 13th (deck available  8/13- 8/31)!

It's our birthday! But YOU get the gifts!
Birthday Event - win with the free birthday deck and get the ability to unlock ANY deck from ANY level! 
SALE! 50% Off 10,000 coins!
Autumn Event - Free Fall deck!

Spooky Season has returned to Solisquare once again...
From October 1-November 4, enjoy the spooky orange app icon and home screen, and treat yourself to the special Halloween Event  – no tricks here!  You can get a free deck that gives you bonus points when you use it, as long as you unlock the deck before the event is over.

Happy Thanksgiving!  I'm thankful for all of you Solisquare players, and I'm giving you something else to be thankful for!  A free Thanksgiving Deck available from November 21-30!  Win with the deck to unlock it forever!  Also, enjoy our seasonal icon color change.

Stay tuned for more big updates coming soon!

We are teaming up with A21 to fight human trafficking. Starting Giving Tuesday through the end of the year, 100% of the proceeds from the purchase of the two new decks will go to A21!
Christmas event - 12 days of Christmas, 12 Christmas decks!

We are teaming up with A21 to fight human trafficking. Starting Giving Tuesday through the end of the year, 100% of the proceeds from the purchase of the two new decks will go to A21!
Christmas event - 12 days of Christmas, 12 Christmas decks!

Fix for setting a special deck not persisting after the app closes.

Happy New Year!
Enjoy the special 2021 deck to celebrate! Available for free for a limited time, so make sure you get it while you can!

If your New Year’s Resolution is to play more Solisquare, we have more goodies for you! A brand new level is available, but it requires lots of points, so get playing! When you reach Level 19 you will have access to the Heroes, Monolith, and (our favorite) Roxy decks! We hope you enjoy!

The special A21 decks are still available for purchase from the main menu! Help end slavery around the globe, and have fun doing it. 

Also, bug/performance fixes.

Solisquare takes it to LEVEL 20
Enjoy 3 new decks: City, Jungle, and Topograph
... if you can get the points to unlock them!  You'll need a total of 2.5 million points to reach level 20!  (PROTIP: to get MEGA POINTS, get huge combos in Arcade mode!)
Also:
Enjoy the Mother's Day Event with a free deck and point bonus!  The deck is unlockable between May 6 and 15.  Have fun!
